title: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
author: Megi Dervishi; Mathurin Videau; Yann LeCun
summary: CrossBERT improves text encoding by separating representation learning from token reconstruction, making training faster and more efficient. Unlike standard BERT, CrossBERT produces better frozen features that work well without full finetuning. This approach helps models scale better and perform stronger on language tasks.
